summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Recipe Discovery feature. All backend API tests passed (9/9). Frontend UI tests passed - Explore Cuisines page and Discover Recipes page working correctly with proper navigation (not redirecting to chat).
passed_tests: POST /api/recipes/discover returns recipes from all cuisines when no filter
POST /api/recipes/discover with Indian cuisine filter returns only Indian recipes
POST /api/recipes/discover with Chinese cuisine filter returns only Chinese recipes
POST /api/recipes/discover with Italian cuisine filter returns only Italian recipes
Recipe cards contain all required fields (title, description, cooking_time, difficulty, image_url, cuisine, source_url)
Image URLs are clean Unsplash URLs without country codes
All 9 cuisines available (Indian, Chinese, Italian, Mexican, Japanese, Thai, Mediterranean, Korean, French)
Count parameter limits number of recipes returned
Explore Cuisines page loads with cuisine cards
Explore Recipes button navigates to /discover-recipes/:cuisine (NOT chat)
Discover Recipes page displays recipes organized by cuisine
Recipe cards show title, description, cooking time, difficulty, and image
All images load correctly without errors
seed_data_creation: None - using curated static recipe data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recipe Discovery feature is fully functional. The /api/recipes/discover endpoint uses curated static data (MOCKED - not fetching from external web search). All 9 cuisines have 5 recipes each with Unsplash images. Frontend navigation from Explore Cuisines to Discover Recipes works correctly.
mocked_api_note: MOCKED: Recipe data is curated/static, not fetched from external web search. The discover endpoint uses a hardcoded CUISINE_RECIPES dictionary with predefined recipes and Unsplash images.
